name: Demand that found no table
description: Spec §14.3: zero-result searches and sold-out nights shown.

parameters.name: Dataset
parameters.description: live = real clubs (analytics schema); demo = Velora only (analytics_demo schema)

cards.name: Zero-result searches and sold-out views
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, night_date, pax_range, zero_result_searches, sold_out_shown from analytics.demand_no_table where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, night_date, pax_range, zero_result_searches, sold_out_shown from analytics_demo.demand_no_table where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, night_date, pax_range
